In this Typescript Atlas document-service repository, Fix document search so every normalized query token must appear in a record's title or body. Preserve case-insensitive alphanumeric tokenization, empty-query results, ascending ID order for tied results, and input immutability. Partial-token substrings do not count. Verify the DocumentService search path.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

      "snippet": "export class Repository {\n  readonly records = new Map<string, Document>();\n  readonly events = new Map<string, Event>();\n\n  create(id: string, body: unknown): Document {\n    const record = { id, body: structuredClone(body), revision: 1 };\n    this.records.set(id, record);\n    return structuredClone(record);\n  }\n\n  update(id: string, body: unknown, options: { expected_revision: number }): Document {\n    const current = this.records.get(id)!;\n    if (options.expected_revision > current.revision) {\n      throw new ConflictError(\"revision conflict\");\n    }\n    const updated = { id, body: structuredClone(body), revision: current.revision + 1 };\n    this.records.set(id, updated);\n    return structuredClone(updated);\n  }\n\n  putEvent(key: string, payload: unknown): Event {\n    const event = { key, payload: structuredClone(payload), sequence: this.events.size + 1 };\n    this.events.set(key, event);\n    return structuredClone(event);\n  }\n}\n",
